name: Roast chicken dinner
title: Roast Chicken Dinner

steps.text: Prep: peel and cut the potatoes, peel the carrots, trim the sprouts.
Salted water on to boil.
Oven on to 180, so it is hot when the chicken goes in.
Roasting tin with oil or fat into the oven now, while it heats up, so the fat is really hot for the potatoes.
steps.note: Owner 18 Oct: the fat was not hot enough when the tin went in with the chicken

steps.text: Water boiling: potatoes in. Tap DONE when they go in, the rest of the plan follows from here.
steps.note: the boil time varies, so this step sets the clock

steps.text: Chicken crown in the oven, 60 minutes at 180 (potatoes have boiled 10 minutes).
Potatoes have boiled 12 minutes: drain, shake to rough them up, let them steam dry.
Potatoes into the hot fat and into the oven, 1 hour. Turn them halfway.
Carrots in the oven, 50 minutes.
Sprouts in the oven, 40 minutes.
Prepare the stuffing: mix it up and put it in its dish, ready to go in the oven in 8 minutes.
steps.note: Owner 18 Oct: 8 minutes before it goes in

steps.text: Turn the potatoes.
Stuffing in the oven, 25 to 30 minutes.
Chicken out. Check it is cooked through, cover with foil and a tea towel to rest. Keep the juices for the gravy.
Turn the carrots and add the honey glaze, 20 minutes to go.
Toss the sprouts and potatoes, and turn the oven up to 200 for the last 20 minutes.
Make the gravy with the chicken juices.
Plates into the plate warmer.
Turn the steamer on, it takes 5 minutes to warm up.
Lay the table and make the drinks. Usually a helper's job.
Spinach into the steamer, 3 to 5 minutes.
Carve the chicken, about 5 minutes.
Everything out of the oven and serve. Enjoy!

prep: Honey glaze mixed (honey, butter, pinch of salt)
equipment: a roasting tin for the chicken
a roasting tray for the potatoes
a small dish for the stuffing
